lines.en: I scoot along just above the sand.

lines.zh: 暖水推着我的鳍，很舒服。
lines.en: The warm water pushes my fins pleasantly.

lines.zh: 我绕着水草茎转了半圈。
lines.en: I loop halfway around a reed stem.

lines.zh: 河底的淤泥被我踢起来。
lines.en: My passing kicks up the river silt.

lines.zh: 我躲进叶子投下的影子里。
lines.en: I slip into the shade of a leaf.

lines.zh: 一小股水把我推向下游。
lines.en: A small surge nudges me downstream.
I slip beneath a flat stone.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴摆得又快又碎。
lines.en: My tail beats quick and choppy.
I skim the sand of the shallows.
My school waits ahead of me.
The weeds sway and I bend with them.
I follow a root into the dark.

lines.zh: 河水带着泥味，我慢下来。
lines.en: The river tastes of mud; I slow.
I rise a short way toward the surface.

lines.zh: 我一口一口啃水草，边啃边走。
lines.en: I nibble the water grass as I go.

lines.zh: 沙上有个小坑，我钻进去半截。
lines.en: There is a small dip in the sand; I settle halfway in.

lines.zh: 大鱼的影子掠过，我立刻停住。
lines.en: A big fish's shadow passes; I freeze at once.

lines.zh: 河底的碎叶被我拨得直打转。
lines.en: I stir the sunken leaves until they swirl.
I lie on the sand, fins barely moving.
A fallen leaf settles beside me.
I nibble twice at the water weeds.
The riverbed's coolness seeps through my belly.
A crab sidles past me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，假装是石头。
lines.en: I stay still and pretend to be a stone.
The water above me murmurs.
I bury my snout a little in the sand.
My companions forage nearby.
Sunlight reaches the shallow floor.
I let out one small bubble.
The weeds hang over my head.
I wait for the river's flow to ease.

lines.zh: 我伸了伸侧鳍，又收回来。
lines.en: I stretch a side fin and fold it back.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，影子很大。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows, a huge shadow.
Your feet have muddied the sand.
I swim to your feet and look.
Are you reaching into the water for me?
I hide underneath your shadow.
Your reflection startles me.
I poke my head toward your boot.
You keep still, so I come closer.

lines.zh: 水底的你比天上的清楚。
lines.en: Your shape below is clearer than above.
I shrink back into the weeds.
A corner of my side fin is bitten off.
I dive into the weeds, trailing blood.
I roll over before I can swim straight.
Blood clouds the water around me.
That blow nearly finished me.
I lie on the sand, panting.
One of my fins has snapped.
I hide in the rock crack and tremble.
I cannot even swim a straight line.
That smell will not leave me.

lines.zh: 你手里那撮水草在滴水。
lines.en: That clump of weed in your hand drips.
I know the smell of tender leaves.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放进水里，我来了。
lines.en: You drop the leaf; here I come.
I circle that little bundle of weed.
I bite once; it is crisp.
Do not take it; I am still eating.
This leaf is softer than the river's.

lines.zh: 我把碎屑一颗颗捡起来。
lines.en: I pick the fragments up one by one.
Your hand moves and I back off.
I edge in from the side.

lines.zh: 我被你的脚背撞了一下。
lines.en: The top of your foot knocks me.

lines.zh: 我撞在树根上，翻了个身。
lines.en: I hit a root and roll over.

lines.zh: 一块石滚下来，把我推开。
lines.en: A stone rolls down and shoves me aside.
A companion crowds me and I tilt.
I blunder into the weeds and snag.
The current pins me to a log.
My snout knocks against a shell.
Your kicked-up water sweeps me away.
I am squeezed toward the shallow bank.
I spin twice before steadying.
She swims up and her tail touches me.
We travel side by side above the sand.
I draw a circle around her.
The edges of her fins are pale.
We slip into the weeds together.

lines.zh: 她用头蹭了蹭我的侧身。
lines.en: She nudges my flank with her head.
This river bend is very quiet.
I stay at her side and will not leave.
Her shadow covers half of me.
We ride the warm current slowly.

lines.zh: 有片叶子沉下来，我顶住。
lines.en: A leaf sinks; I prop it on my snout.

lines.zh: 我把一颗小螺含在嘴里。
lines.en: I hold a small snail in my mouth.
It is too heavy and slips away.
I push a grain of sand about.
I pile leaf bits beside a stone.
Something is caught by my gill.
I try to crack the shell open.
I carry it a short distance.
It drops from my mouth to the bed.

lines.zh: 我把能吃的那点挑出来。
lines.en: I pick out the parts I can eat.
That patch of weed is swaying.
I see a grub on the leaf.

lines.zh: 河底有新的嫩芽冒出来。
lines.en: A fresh shoot has come up.
A little clump drifts down.
I smell fresh green matter.
A bright thread runs through the water.
I head for that shallow patch.

lines.zh: 一片叶子正好落在我面前。
lines.en: A leaf lands right in front of me.
I choose the tenderest stem.
Fine weed grows in the rock crack.

lines.zh: 我一点一点靠近那片叶子。
lines.en: I approach that leaf bit by bit.
It sways; I stop.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子慢慢蹭过去。
lines.en: I tilt sideways and ease in.
Half a finger's width to go.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看有没有大鱼。
lines.en: I glance around for big fish first.
Sure it is safe, I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的嘴已经碰到叶边了。
lines.en: My mouth already touches the leaf edge.

lines.zh: 我一点声音都没发出来。
lines.en: I make no sound at all.
It lies on the sand, very close.
I lower my body slowly.

lines.zh: 我咬了它一口，它没反应。
lines.en: I bite it once and it does not react.
My head nudges against its shell.
My nudge rolls it over.
My teeth are too small to pierce.
I tear off a little piece of leaf.
It simply snaps under my bite.
It knocks me back instead.
I shake my head and toss it away.
This wound means little to it.
I bite and swim off.
I open my eyes in the warm river.
The sand beneath me is soft.

lines.zh: 两条同伴跟我一起来的。
lines.en: Two companions arrived with me.
The weeds filter the light above.

lines.zh: 我从浅滩慢慢游向深处。
lines.en: I move from the shallows toward depth.
Roots and fallen leaves are here.
The river smells of wet earth.

lines.zh: 我找了块平坦的沙停下。
lines.en: I find a flat patch of sand and settle.
A school of small fish crosses nearby.

lines.zh: 我第一次碰这么暖的水。
lines.en: I have never felt water this warm.

lines.zh: 河水变烫，我拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The river turns hot; I dive for depth.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，沙硌得疼。
lines.en: Flung onto the bank, the sand scrapes me.

lines.zh: 被捞上岸，我的鳃黏住了。
lines.en: Hauled ashore, my gills cling shut.
The bed shakes and I am thrown up.

lines.zh: 一支尖东西擦过我的背。
lines.en: Something sharp grazes my back.
Hex magic soaks into my small bones.
The weeds are gone and I am starving.

lines.zh: 雷电打进河里，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river; I go numb.
The riverbed opens and I drop through.
